status_read_site_check.method: For each mapped body, literal load resolving to 0x40008064 is immediately followed by original LDR r0,[r0]; hook address is that actual peripheral-read instruction.

limitations: All 24 handlers are tested only through the prefix before first publish literal and under the fixed common input state documented by the candidate; no complete return/frame claim.

Readiness changes are injected at the original status-read instruction; this models boundary timing and is not physical peripheral evidence. At the 60-delay limit, no extra status read observes a later-ready transition.
Other flags, active op4, broader inputs, hardware/concurrency, ownership, and whole-handler coverage remain unresolved.
